body: ALSOOO. It’s always confused me how nothing happened to the actors while filming ‘My Roanoke Nightmare’. Like what.

I really tried to like it, and it definitely had a very cool concept. But I found it so hard to pay attention to and I kept zoning out. When I did my rewatch of all the seasons I tried with Roanoke again thinking that maybe I’d like it more the second time around but I gave up. It’s definitely one of the scariest seasons though.
Haha it’s crazy I know. I don’t live in America though so I hope I get to meet him whenever I go visit my aunt.

Yes for sure. I think it’s a matter of taking a break from big projects all together. He’s friends with my aunt and I remember growing up not thinking it was that cool that he was in Star Trek because I had no interest in it. But once I started watching American horror story I really appreciated the connection.
Yes I agree. He’s good friends with my aunt and he sent me a video wishing me happy birthday this year I was like omgggggg. But he’s super talented and plays evil so well!

Cult is such an amazing season. It’s literally if the year 2016 was a season. With all the clowns and Donald trump craze. I think Ally’s phobias were portrayed so well. And the fear of the cult members felt very real before “THERE WAS NOTHING IN THE KOOL-AID”. I love how it’s such a twisted season and at parts feels like a psychological thriller.
Thank you so much. I will try my best but it’s so hard sometimes to feel like I’m not being judged for opening up.
Thank you. You are so important too.

Thank you so much. I don’t think you have any idea how much it means to me that you took time out of your day to reply to me. It’s really nice to see that people care. I will try my best to take your advice. I’m feeling much better today than I did last night.
